plans.note: Section 21 sets a mutual cap at greater of 12 months' Fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, with Excluded Claims defined in 21.3 (confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnity, gross negligence/wilful misconduct/fraud, IP infringement) and a consequential-damages carve-back in 21.2 treating data restoration and replacement services as direct. Also check 18.2 (insurance does not limit liability) and 19.4/20.5 for interaction with remedies. Likely compliant.

Vendor IP indemnity in 20.1 and misconduct/law/data-breach indemnity in 20.2; Customer's indemnity in 20.3 is narrow with proper exclusions; procedure in 20.4 and IP remedies in 20.5 (cross-referenced by termination right in 9.3). Confirm indemnities are outside the liability cap via 21.3.

Section 12.3 expressly preserves Customer's freedom to develop, buy, or sell anything and disclaims non-compete/MFN/no-hire commitments. Check 2.2 (exclusivity) only under EXCLUSIVITY to avoid double-flagging the same term.

Sec-2.2 (first of two 2.2s) makes Vendor Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics — a direct hit on this rule, notwithstanding the contrary language in 2.1 and 12.3. Note the internal conflict when drafting.

Sec-7.2 (first of two 7.2s) requires Customer to give Vendor terms no less favourable than its best terms to any other technology supplier — an MFN running against us. 12.3 disclaims any MFN commitment; flag the conflict.

Sec-12.4 binds Customer for eighteen months post-termination, covers any person employed at any time during the term, bars engagement as well as solicitation, and has no general-advertising carve-out. 12.3's general-recruitment freedom conflicts.

Section 9 contains only for-cause, insolvency and Vendor-default termination rights (9.1–9.3, 9.5); there is no numbered 9.4 and no convenience right for Customer. Confirm no convenience exit sits in 8.x, 10.2 or 27.3 before marking missing.

Sec-8.2 auto-renews Order Forms for twelve months on a 180-day non-renewal notice — an unusually long window. Uplift is controlled in 8.3 (lesser of CPI and 3%, 90 days' notice, no increase on prepaid periods), which mitigates pricing risk.

New York law with CISG excluded (28.1) and exclusive New York County courts with injunctive-relief carve-out (28.2); 28.3 adds a non-blocking executive escalation. Within accepted list; likely compliant.

24.1 gives Customer free affiliate/successor assignment; 24.2 restricts Vendor including change of control; 24.4 bars Vendor termination or repricing on our change of control; 13.3 permits transfer of licence rights in step with Section 24.

Customer owns Customer Data and pre-existing IP (14.1) and Deliverables are assigned on creation subject to payment (14.2); Vendor Technology retained but back-licensed via 13.2/14.3; 14.4 handles joint IP and feedback; 15.1 bars model training on Customer Data. Likely compliant.

13.1 covers Affiliates and contractors for internal business purposes; 13.2 gives a perpetual paid-up licence for delivered/embedded Vendor Technology; 13.3 limits revocation/suspension to material uncured breach after notice and cure. Restrictions in 13.4 are narrow. Likely compliant.

Sec-22.1 permits Vendor to audit at any time without notice with remote access to Customer systems — fails notice, frequency and off-site expectations, and conflicts with 22.2's bar on direct system access. 22.2 cost allocation and 22.3 confidentiality of findings are acceptable; Section 23 may hold related records duties.
Sec-7.6 imposes USD 25,000 per day liquidated damages on Customer for any dependency delay — uncapped and one-directional against us. No offsetting service credits appear in the main body.

19.1–19.3 give services, conformity, authority, malicious-code and compliance warranties; 19.2 runs 90 days for Deliverables and the whole subscription term for hosted Services; 19.4 gives repair/re-perform then terminate-and-refund and is expressly non-exclusive for major claims. Likely compliant.

Section 18 sets CGL, workers' comp, employer's liability, E&O and USD 5M cyber cover for the term plus one year, with certificates, primary status and a statement that insurance does not cap Vendor liability. Likely compliant.

Sec-2.1 states no minimum quantity or purchase commitment and that declining further Order Forms is not a breach; 7.1 bars unstated minimum-use charges; 12.3 disclaims minimum-volume commitments. Likely compliant.

Section 11 provides up to six months' transition assistance at expiring rates, data return within thirty days in machine-readable form with no fee-dispute hostage, and certified deletion; 10.1–10.2 cover surviving rights and refunds. Likely compliant.
